info.name: MonkoraEdge Core Auth API
info.description: Postman collection for MonkoraEdge Core Auth API (updated 2026-03-27). Includes Auth, OAuth2/OIDC, and IAM management flows with PKCE helpers and token auto-save scripts.

request.description: Start Authorization Code + PKCE flow. Pre-request script auto-generates codeVerifier/codeChallenge (S256).
Alternative authorize entrypoint with same semantics as GET for compatibility tests.
Submit user consent. Origin/Referer headers are included to satisfy same-origin CSRF guard in API.
Exchange authorization code for tokens. Refresh token is returned only when offline_access scope was granted.
Rotate refresh token and obtain a fresh access token pair.
Client credentials grant. API requires explicit scope (no implicit default scope).
Revoke token for current authenticated client. Pre-request script auto-builds Basic auth header from clientId/clientSecret.
Validate token activity/status for authorized client. Pre-request script auto-builds Basic auth header.

body.raw:
{
  "clientName": "Updated Demo SPA",
  "requirePkce": true,
  "requireConsent": false,
  "redirectUris": ["http://localhost:3000/auth/callback"],
  "postLogoutRedirectUris": ["http://localhost:3000/"],
  "allowedGrantTypes": ["AUTHORIZATION_CODE", "REFRESH_TOKEN"],
  "allowedResponseTypes": ["code"],
  "scopeIds": ["{{scopeId}}"],
  "accessTokenLifetime": 3600,
  "refreshTokenLifetime": 2592000,
  "logoUri": null,
  "clientUri": "http://localhost:3000",
  "isActive": true
}
